name: statusline-pro
description: A configurable status line under the prompt: model, effort, context, rate limits, directory, git, cost and badges from other mods. Settings: /statusline-pro settings.

show_week.title: 7d limit
show_week.description: auto shows it once usage passes the threshold below

show_git.title: Git
show_git.description: Branch, dirty mark and unpushed commits

show_cost.title: Cost
show_cost.description: auto shows it once the session cost passes the minimum below

week_min_pct.title: 7d limit threshold (%)
week_min_pct.description: Usage at which auto shows the 7d limit

cost_min_usd.title: Cost minimum (USD)
cost_min_usd.description: Session cost at which auto shows the cost

order.title: Order
order.description: Comma list of segment ids, first to last; the rest follow in default order

hidden_segments.title: Hidden extras
hidden_segments.description: Comma list of drop-in segment ids to hide (ext:<file name>)
